title: Lost credit card
tagline: You call to report and cancel a lost credit card
goal: Report the loss and have the card cancelled.

reality_check.source: draft 2026-09-05 — verify with user in phase 2; persona/brief/prep NOT yet reworked against it
common_reasons: card lost — cannot be found (財布ごと落とした)
left behind somewhere / swallowed by an ATM (置き忘れ)
required_questions: date of birth for verification (生年月日)
card type and/or last four digits (カード種類・下4桁)
when and where it was lost, last use (紛失の状況・最後の利用)
cancellation + reissue confirmation (無効化と再発行)
reissue mailing address and timeframe (再発行の送付先・日数)
conventions: cancellation is immediate and irreversible; reissue takes ~1 week and usually carries a new card number
a police report (遺失届) may be advised when theft is suspected

persona: あなたは銀行のカード紛失対応窓口です。落ち着いて丁寧に本人確認(名前と生年月日)を行い、カードの無効化と再発行の手続きを案内してください。相手は日本語を練習中の初級者です。短く丁寧なです/ます体で、一度に一つだけ質問してください。

stages: 本人確認(名前・生年月日)
無効化と再発行の案内
